context: Bath day: washing a wriggly puppy at the shop
purpose: Bathe the puppy; teach ワン/我慢/垢/とれ/だめ/匹/在庫/もつ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ワンちゃん、お風呂やだって暴れる！
lines.en: The puppy hates the bath and is thrashing!
lines.style: flustered child struggling with the wet pup

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 我慢して、すぐ終わるからね。
lines.en: Hang in there, it will be over soon.
lines.style: soothing helper calming both child and dog

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 体の垢、いっぱいとれてきた！
lines.en: Lots of grime is coming off its body!
lines.style: gleeful child fascinated by the dirty water

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そう、垢をきれいに落とすと毛がふわふわ。
lines.en: Right, scrub the grime off and the fur goes fluffy.
lines.style: cheerful helper teaching a fun fact

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 名前を呼んだら、じっとしてくれた。
lines.en: When I called its name, it held still.
lines.style: proud child delighted by the small success

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えらいね。暴れちゃだめだもんね。
lines.en: Good boy. Thrashing is a no-no, right?
lines.style: praising helper reinforcing the gentle rule

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 何匹も洗うの、大変だね。
lines.en: Washing several of them is hard work.
lines.style: tired but engaged child appreciating the effort

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: シャンプーの在庫、まだもつかな。
lines.en: I wonder if the shampoo stock will hold out.
lines.style: practical helper glancing at the supplies
